contexts.text: The representatives or types of the Church.
Under representative types...
So that all things were involved in types...
Were types of Him...
The manners and faces are types of the interiors.

External things are only types and representatives of internal ones; as the action of a man is a representative type of his thought and will; and as a work of charity is a representative type of the charity which is within... So all the rites of the Jewish Church were representative types of the Lord...
Made to every type of the celestial and spiritual things in the three Heavens.
Appeared as if printed with types, such as are in this Earth. AC 6930:end. SE 3232.
In these are Divine truth and good in representative types; for external things relate by a type... to internal ones. AC 8932:2.
Finally, writing was published by types. This was provided by the Lord for the sake of the Word.
In which, as in types, internal things are presented.
I told them that in our Earth writing can be published by types... SE 1677.
He is then in the things themselves, and not in their types.
All the affections of the mind present themselves in the natural form as in their type.
Papers have been sent me (from Heaven) exactly like those... published by types.
This writing, which is made by types of a heavenly form, is in use in the Inmost Heaven...
He has an external form, which is the type or effigy of his internals...
I spoke with the Angels... about the types here...
For spiritual things are there effigied in all their type, in an appearance as it were natural.
The letters with the Angels of the Spiritual Kingdom are like the typographical letters in our world. TCR 241.
They presented the initial form of man in a type before my eyes.
Faces are the types of the loves...
The word jealousy is derived from type of zeal; and there is a type or image of a just and of an unjust zeal.
The universals of the world are perpetual types of the infinity...
The typicals of the mineral kingdom...
That you may see the creation of the universe in a particular type.
Before the Lord's Advent, worship consisted in types and figures.
Before the (time of the Lord) all the Churches were representative and typical; and were such types and representations, that...
(Then) you will see charity in its type.
The whole world is full of representations and types of regeneration.
Also publish (the doctrines of the New Church) by types.
When such were present while I was reading the things which have been written concerning the Word, and printed with types, they took away all delight...
(Cicero) wondered at the types of our time.
Man was created to the type of both worlds...
For in this Earth such things are committed to paper, and then to types...
Spirits can commit their speech to paper... as is usual with the things published with types...
Letters composed with type, seen. Explained. (As if with types. DMin 4778. DMin 4790.)
In a lower sphere... they are presented in such forms and types.
Their face is the type of their mind.
As it is in the least types, so it is in the greatest...
In these things, as in their types, the Angels see... their own affections.
The creation of the universe seen from its types in the Heavens...
5. Other types of this Thing come forth in both kingdoms...
The writing of the spiritual Word is from letters like the typographical letters of our world.
Without this free will, man... would be only a type and image.
Jehovah then raised up the Israelitish Church in which He might restore the primitive types... Such types were all the tabernacles, feasts, etc.
Thus they turned heavenly types into infernal types; and the Divine things of Heaven and the Church into idols.
All things of their Church were made representative; thus they worshipped Jehovah by means of types which affected their senses, and at the same time corresponded to spiritual things.
